Review of Commercial Office Lease Agreement — Clause 14.2 (Early Termination):
- Notice requirement: Tenant must furnish written notice to Landlord at least ninety (90) calendar days prior to the expiration of the second anniversary of the Commencement Date.
- Early exit fee: Sum equivalent to two (2) months of the then-prevailing Base Rent plus unamortized tenant improvement allowance.
- Security deposit: Landlord shall return the $15,000 security deposit less verified repair deductions within thirty (30) days following full surrender of keys and broom-clean inspection.
